purpose: Preserve the distinction between correctly adjudicated known provenance candidates and an actually exhaustive repository-wide provenance search.
sources_inspected: connector branch-search result for an empty query

observed: Known immutable status records for M-004, M-005, and M-006 have already been adjudicated as downstream references rather than assigning sources.
The active queue still requires an exhaustive branch inventory or equivalent reachable-history traversal before any identifier may be classified as unlocated after exhaustive coverage.
The available empty-query branch-search call returned no branches and therefore cannot serve as an exhaustive inventory receipt.
inferred: Candidate correctness and search completeness are independent evidence dimensions.
A provenance conclusion can remain fail-closed even when every inspected candidate has been classified correctly, because uninspected branches or commits may contain an earlier assigning source.
proposed: Require every exhaustive-origin claim to include a schema-valid traversal receipt binding raw branch inventory, raw reachable-commit traversal, candidate records, claim states, provider-ceiling ambiguity, and explicit violations.
superseded: Any implicit treatment of a default-branch file search, recent commit sample, or empty connector branch result as repository-wide exhaustive coverage.
unresolved: The authoritative assigning source for M-004 remains unlocated.
The authoritative assigning source for M-005 remains unlocated.
The authoritative assigning source for M-006 remains unlocated.
No complete raw branch inventory and reachable-commit traversal receipt has yet been retained.

contradiction_resolution.resolved: A correct rejection of known status records as assigning sources does not satisfy the separate acceptance criterion for exhaustive branch and history coverage.
contradiction_resolution.preserved_boundary: Until a complete receipt exists, the identifiers may be described only as unresolved under current coverage, not absent repository-wide or unlocated after exhaustive coverage.

privacy.boundary: Repository metadata, abstract claim classifications, and contract fields only; no private chat or File Library text is copied.

falsification_route: Retain a complete independently reviewable branch inventory and reachable-commit traversal whose raw counts reconcile, whose provider ceiling is unambiguous, and whose candidate set contains an earlier immutable object that explicitly assigns an identifier and passes namespace, authority, semantic-role, temporal-precedence, and immutable-locator agreement.
